title: Guarding a map
hints: Maps are not safe for concurrent use. Concurrent writes can crash the program with "fatal error: concurrent map writes".
Lock c.mu at the start of Inc and Get and unlock it when they return. defer c.mu.Unlock() right after Lock keeps that tidy.
func (c *Container) Inc(name string) { c.mu.Lock(); defer c.mu.Unlock(); c.counters[name]++ }  — and the same in Get
